lines: Every K.O.L. deal runs on trust.
K.O.L. Escrow. The post stays up. The K.O.L. gets paid.
A project posts a campaign, with the budget already locked on NEAR. K.O.L.s apply with their price.
The project accepts, and that K.O.L.'s fee moves into a deal. The project can't pull it back.
The K.O.L. posts on X, and submits the link.
An agent reads the post on X, for free, and starts the hold window.
Post stays up, the K.O.L. gets paid. Post gets deleted, the project gets refunded. Every reason is recorded on chain.
And the agent can't run off with the money. Its key can only record, release, or refund.
Paid K.O.L.s can cash out to U.S.D.C. on another chain, through NEAR Intents.
It's live on NEAR testnet. Try it free. No wallet app needed.
